title: Full Stack Engineer - Python
description:
**Summary**
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
  
  
AI & Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS&T's engine for AI-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning — including generative AI — along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple.
  
  
**Description**
You will work within a globally distributed engineering organization supporting Finance business processes and analytical applications.
  
  
The role involves building applications that bring together data from multiple enterprise sources and convert it into actionable reporting, analytics, insights, and decision-support capabilities.
  
  
You will work closely with Finance business partners, data engineers, software engineers, product owners, architects, and other Apple engineering teams across India, the United States, Europe, and APAC.
  
  
You should be comfortable working across the stack — from backend APIs and data processing to databases and modern user interfaces — while maintaining high standards for software quality, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and operate scalable reporting and analytical applications for Apple Finance business users.
* Build backend services and APIs primarily using Python and FastAPI.
* Develop responsive, intuitive web applications using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Node.js.
* Design APIs and services that expose analytical, transactional, and financial data securely and efficiently.
* Build data processing and integration components connecting enterprise databases, data warehouses, APIs, and event-driven systems.
* Work with large datasets using SQL and modern analytical data platforms.
* Collaborate directly with Finance partners to understand business processes, reporting requirements, pain points, and opportunities for automation.
* Translate business requirements into well-designed technical solutions.
* Participate in architecture and detailed design discussions.
* Own assigned applications or components from design through development, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
* Write clean, modular, reusable, and well-tested production-quality code.
* Perform thoughtful code reviews and help improve engineering standards across the team.
* Diagnose production issues and identify root causes rather than addressing symptoms only.
* Design systems with reliability, scalability, observability, performance, security, and maintainability in mind.
* Develop automated unit, integration, API, and UI tests.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices.
* Partner with data engineering teams on ingestion, transformation, data quality, and analytical datasets where required.
* Mentor interns and junior engineers through design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and engineering best practices.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering or data application development experience.
* Strong programming skills in Python with good understanding of object-oriented and functional programming concepts.
* Experience developing production APIs or backend applications using FastAPI, Flask, Django, or comparable Python frameworks.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, HTTP fundamentals, API contracts, error handling, authentication, and service integration.
* Experience developing modern web applications using React and JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with Node.js and modern frontend/backend development tooling.
* Strong SQL skills and practical experience working with relational or analytical databases.
* Experience with databases/data platforms such as Snowflake, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SingleStore, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of software engineering fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, API design, testing, debugging, and version control.
* Experience writing automated unit and integration tests.
* Good understanding of distributed application fundamentals including reliability, scalability, availability, latency, security, and observability.
* Experience using Git and participating in collaborative development and code-review workflows.
* Ability to independently investigate problems and deliver solutions with limited supervision.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building reporting, analytics, financial, accounting, payments, commerce, or enterprise applications.
* Understanding of how business transactions flow through operational systems and ultimately affect financial reporting or accounting.
* Experience with Snowflake and large-scale analytical datasets.
* Experience with data engineering technologies and concepts including ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data modelling, data quality, and orchestration.
* Experience with Apache Spark / PySpark.
* Exposure to event-driven systems such as Kafka.
* Experience with NoSQL databases such as Cassandra or similar distributed data stores.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
* Experience with frontend testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Playwright.
* Experience with Python testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Understanding of caching, asynchronous processing, concurrency, API performance optimization, and distributed system patterns.
* Experience implementing observability through metrics, structured logging, tracing, and alerting.
* Experience reviewing code written by other engineers.
* Previous experience mentoring interns or junior engineers.
* Ability to take an ambiguous requirement and independently drive it through technical design and implementation.

title: Developer II-.Net Fullstack Developer
description:
**Overview**
As a Software Developer II on the Smart Water pod, you will build the customer-facing Smart Water experience inside the RealPage Smart Building Portal and the services behind it. You will work across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL, integrating meter and usage data from upstream systems.
  
  
A core part of the mission is making Smart Water scale: replacing today's manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service workflows, hardening the data-ingestion pipeline, and building water-usage anomaly detection that flags running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, and abnormal consumption for operators.
  
  
This role suits a developer with a few years of full-stack experience who wants to own medium-sized features end to end in a small, high-ownership pod and grow into the product's AI roadmap (a Smart Water MCP that powers a Lumina Copilot).
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Smart Water features across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL.
* Integrate meter, usage, and occupancy data from upstream systems and improve the reliability of the ingestion pipeline.
* Develop water-usage anomaly detection that surfaces sustained anomalies (running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, abnormal usage) from interval meter data.
* Replace manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service setup and data-management workflows.
* Surface Smart Water inside the Smart Building Portal (SBP) and contribute to the Smart Water MCP that powers Lumina AI workflows.
* Write clean, well-tested code and partner closely with the pod's QA engineer on quality and data integrity.

**Qualifications**
This is a full-stack role on a C#/.NET 8 and Angular codebase backed by MSSQL.
  
  

* 2+ years building production software, full- stack or backend-leaning.
* Proficiency in C#/.NET (ASP.NET Web API) and solid SQL / relational data-modeling skills (MSSQL).
* Front-end experience with Angular or a similar modern framework.
* Experience integrating and consuming REST APIs and working with upstream/third-party data sources.
* Comfort writing tested, maintainable code and working in a CI/CD workflow (Azure DevOps).
* Extensive hands-on experience with Claude Code or a similar agentic coding harness (required).
* Demonstrated experience with agentic coding workflows — using AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development (required).

**Preferred Required**
**Preferred Skills but not required**

* Experience with data-pipeline / ingestion work and diagnosing data-quality issues.
* Exposure to IoT, metering, or utility/submetering domains.
* Experience with ElasticSearch .
* Interest in applied AI — building MCP servers or LLM-powered features (e.g., a Lumina Copilot).
* Familiarity with OIDC / single sign-on integration.

— LLM-powered pipelines, agentic workflows, retrieval over heterogeneous healthcare data, evaluation harnesses, and the orchestration layer that sits between our signal foundation and the brand manager's morning brief. You'll thrive here if you enjoy living at the seam between LLMs, traditional ML, and well-engineered backend systems — and if you care about making AI
**useful, reliable, and measurably better**
in a regulated, real-world domain.

**Key Responsibilities**

  **LLM and agentic AI systems**

  **retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)**
  systems leveraging Doceree’s clinical intent signals, campaign data, market intelligence, and partner datasets.

  **agentic workflows and orchestration patterns**
  including tool use, planning, structured outputs, guardrails, and multi-step reasoning.

  **evaluation, monitoring, and observability**

  **model selection, architecture, vendor partnerships, and build-vs-buy tradeoffs**

  **cost management of AI systems**

* Serve as the

  , mentoring future team members and helping shape the long-term AI roadmap for the organization.
* Stay current with advances in LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, and AI infrastructure, and evaluate where emerging technologies can create competitive advantage.

* B. Tech / M.Tech / Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 6–12 years of software engineering and AI/ML experience, including at least 2–3 years building production
  **LLM, generative AI, or agent-based applications**
  .
* Strong hands-on programming experience in
  **Python**
  and modern software engineering practices, including system design, testing, API development, and cloud-native architectures.
* Proven experience building and deploying AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, agents, recommendation systems, search, or related technologies.
* Experience with modern AI frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex**
  , Semantic Kernel, or equivalent custom implementations.
* Experience designing evaluation frameworks and monitoring production AI systems beyond simple prompt experimentation.
* Strong understanding of classical ML/DL techniques and libraries (
  **scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, SpaCy, NumPy, Pandas**
  ) and when
  *not*
  to use an LLM.
* Experience building and operating services on AWS using technologies such as
  **ECS/EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, Bedrock**
  , or equivalent cloud platforms.
* Ability to operate independently, make architectural decisions, and drive projects from concept through production with minimal oversight.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building
  **multi-agent or workflow-oriented AI systems**
  .
* Experience with vector databases, retrieval systems, embeddings, and search infrastructure.
* Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps tooling, model monitoring, and experimentation platforms.
* Experr other data-rich regulated environments. Experience with claims, Rx, EHR-derived signals, HCP identity, campaign telemetry, attribution, and awareness of HIPAA / GDPR / DPDP considerations is a big plus.

  **containerization and orchestration**
